title: Apply luxury glassmorphism navigation + cinematic hero + dark section consistency on Home page

requirements.text: Update the global navigation header to be fully transparent with a premium glassmorphism effect at the top of the page: backdrop blur 10–15px, very subtle white tint (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), thin soft border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), and white navigation text. Remove the current solid/dark filled header background.

quotes: Remove the solid blue/navy background
Make navigation fully transparent
Add glassmorphism effect: backdrop blur (10–15px) very subtle white tint (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) thin soft border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1))
Keep text white
Navigation should feel floating and premium No heavy colors.

acceptanceCriteria: Header no longer renders with an opaque background at page top (no solid fill).
Header uses blur and subtle tint/border consistent with the provided RGBA values (or visually equivalent), and nav link text renders in white.
Desktop and mobile header states both follow the transparent glass styling (including the opened mobile menu area).

requirements.text: Implement scroll-based header styling: when the page is scrolled, slightly increase blur and opacity and add a very subtle darker tint (deep navy/charcoal at low opacity) while keeping the header glassy (not a solid bar).

quotes: On scroll: Increase blur slightly Increase opacity slightly Add a very subtle darker tint (deep navy / charcoal at low opacity) It should still feel glassy and floating — not like a solid bar.

acceptanceCriteria: When at top of page, header uses the baseline transparent glass style.
After scrolling down, header transitions (smoothly) to a slightly stronger blur/opacity with a subtle dark tint; it never becomes an opaque/solid bar.
Scroll state transitions are animated and do not cause layout shift.

requirements.text: Increase the header logo size to approximately 1.5× the current size while keeping alignment clean across breakpoints and ensuring it does not overlap navigation or push layout awkwardly.

quotes: Logo size slightly larger (about 1.5x current)

acceptanceCriteria: Logo height/visual prominence increases ~1.5× compared to current sizing on both mobile and desktop.
Header height and spacing remain balanced; navigation remains accessible and not clipped at common viewport sizes.

requirements.text: Refine the Home page hero section to match a cinematic-but-clean luxury editorial style: use a sharp, high-resolution equestrian placeholder image (close-up leather saddle/bridle detail, warm brown tones, shallow depth of field, natural lighting), remove heavy/dark overlays, and apply only a very subtle top gradient for text readability while keeping the image crisp and visible.

quotes: Use a clear, sharp, high-resolution equestrian image
Remove heavy dark overlay
Apply only a very subtle gradient (top slightly darker for text readability)
Keep background image visible and crisp
Use a premium placeholder for now that fits a luxury editorial style (close-up leather saddle, bridle detail, warm brown tones, shallow depth of field, natural lighting).
The image must be sharp, not overly filtered, and not darkened too much.

acceptanceCriteria: Hero background image appears sharp and not overly filtered; overlay does not significantly darken the image.
Hero overlay is limited to a subtle top gradient for readability (lighter than the current heavy overlay).
Hero still maintains adequate text contrast/readability over the image.

requirements.text: Update hero typography and CTA button styling to match the requested direction: large elegant serif headline in white/soft warm white with a slight text shadow; generous spacing; primary button in warm gold; secondary button transparent with a white border; both buttons have a subtle hover lift animation (2–4px) with smooth transitions (avoid heavy scaling).

quotes: Large elegant serif headline
White or soft warm white text
Add slight text shadow for readability
Keep spacing generous
Primary: warm gold
Secondary: transparent with white border
Subtle hover animation (lift + smooth transition)

acceptanceCriteria: Hero headline renders as an elegant serif with increased prominence and a subtle text shadow; spacing around hero elements feels more spacious than current.
Primary hero CTA uses a warm gold fill; secondary hero CTA is transparent with a white border and white text.
On hover, hero CTAs lift subtly (translateY) with smooth transitions; no aggressive scaling.

requirements.text: Restyle the Home page features/highlights cards as floating glass panels over a deep navy/charcoal section background: card background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop blur, thin soft border, subtle shadow, rounded corners, and a smooth hover lift of 2–4px. Remove/avoid heavy beige/grey blocks and avoid switching to ivory or light sections for this features area.

quotes: Glass Effect Cards (Features Section) Apply glassmorphism style: • background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08) • backdrop blur • thin soft border • subtle shadow • rounded corners • smooth hover lift (2–4px) • no heavy beige or grey blocks
Use a deep navy / charcoal background behind the glass cards. Do NOT use another image in that section.

acceptanceCriteria: The highlights/features section background is deep navy/charcoal (solid, minimal) with no additional background image.
Feature cards use the specified glass look (rgba(255,255,255,0.08) + blur + thin border + subtle shadow) and appear as floating panels.
Hover on cards lifts them by ~2–4px with smooth transition; no heavy glow or thick borders.

requirements.text: Enforce Home page section background consistency and spacing: reduce/replace alternating light backgrounds so the page uses mostly deep dark navy/charcoal with restrained transparent overlays; avoid white-heavy sections and flat grey sections; increase vertical spacing/breathing room between sections and slightly increase heading sizes where needed to maintain an editorial premium feel.

quotes: Section Background Consistency Do NOT alternate too many colors. Use mostly: • Deep dark navy / charcoal • Transparent overlays • Very soft warm neutral only where needed Avoid white-heavy sections. Avoid flat grey sections.
Typography & Spacing • Increase vertical spacing between sections • Use more breathing room • Headings slightly larger • Clean, elegant typography • No overcrowding

acceptanceCriteria: Home page no longer alternates multiple distinct light section backgrounds (e.g., ivory/blue-tint) in a way that feels busy; overall reads as restrained dark luxury.
Section spacing is increased and consistent; content does not feel cramped.
No new sections/components are introduced; changes are styling and light layout spacing adjustments only.

constraints: Frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui must not be edited directly; compose them as-is.
Do not modify the immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep existing site structure/components intact; implement visual refinements only.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Backend changes (Motoko canister logic, schema, or endpoints).
Adding new pages, routes, or content sections beyond restyling existing Home/header UI.
Implementing third-party asset sourcing pipelines; use generated/static placeholder assets instead.

edits: Generate a sharper, luxury editorial equestrian close-up (warm brown leather saddle/bridle detail, shallow depth of field, natural lighting; not overly dark or filtered) (hero-equestrian.dim_1600x900.png > hero-equestrian-editorial.dim_1600x900.png)
